column5: 25. ff:20219 (`cleanup_actions_match`): tests accept any subset or reordering of the read results' discards (ff:20644-20649); the empty list is not asserted. Marked open by gap_002 because the body was not read.

28. EM/object_artifact.rs:1673-1675: a foreign call whose record has no descriptor input passes; a call that should have a guard but whose record omits it would pass.
